column1: # nasty-inputs.tsv: the nasty input forms every reader of this repository loops over (plugin/scripts/nasty-inputs.test.sh). Data, not code: a new form is a new row.
# A copy of the maintainers' machine-wide list, kept here because the public export and its CI cannot read another repository.
# A form is never removed because nothing failed on it.
# Columns, separated by one tab: id, slot, spec, build, why.
#   slot name        spec is Python escape text (\uXXXX, \xNN, \t, \n) for a file name and a folder name; LONG:<n> is n letters
#   slot name-bytes  spec is the bytes of a name written as \xNN; a disk that refuses them SKIPs the form, it never fails it
#   slot input-file  spec names a damaged copy of a valid input file of the reader (the reader's own idea of a valid one)
#   slot shape       spec names a file system shape built around a valid input
#   build: what to create, in plain words, so any project can build it without reading another project's tests.
#   why: what goes wrong without the form; the code of the ticket or review that found it comes last, in brackets.
